_comment: Effect lines on five issues (v385): Data Centers (datacenter_growth, datacenter_water, datacenter_power), Water Conservation (water), Housing Affordability (housing), Protect Public Lands (lands_preserve) and Expand Domestic Energy Production (energy_production). Every federal pair mapped to these keys already printed a line before this pass, and no measure is mapped to any data-center key. That leaves the Utah pairs below, 31 of them, none of which stores a `did`; each was read from its own stored title alone, in wave 4's form. Where the title names what the act did, one line was written from that title and the enacted status, and is stored once in consistency.js _DOS_EFFECT under the FIVE ISSUES SLICE 16 marker; `term` is the title words the line carries. Where it does not, the row stays silent and `why` says what the title lacks. No line names a tally: the one roll on file for each is a single-chamber vote, two of them on concurrence. Read by scripts/test-five-issue-effect-lines.mjs. No score, weight, mapping or key is read from or written to here.
